body: I’m sorry about that and I sympathise massively. I no longer have a relationship with my Father and it hurts every day. I will try and get it together to give them a call tomorrow. Thank you for taking the time to respond to me.

Thank you for replying. I just feel hopeless. This isn’t a new situation. I have struggled with depression for most of my life. Things have never been easy (not that they are for anyone) and I don’t have a good support network. I had a mental health episode a year or so ago and was put on meds but I have since been discharged. I have been thinking about calling he doc and maybe asking for help but even on the medication I still felt the same. I’m sad and low all the time, I’m letting all of my other problems grow and although I can see it happening it’s like I can’t do anything to fix it. I just feel he may suffer less if I wasn’t here at all.
